environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with AWS WAF v2 WebACL attached. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 in COUNT mode for baseline telemetry, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-length-constraint' at priority 200 that blocks any request where any single query string parameter value exceeds 64 bytes (action: BLOCK, field: SingleQueryArgument matching on 'value' with SizeConstraint GT 64), and (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 in COUNT mode only (not blocking) for detection metrics. CloudWatch alarms trigger on SQLi detection counts but do not block requests. The ECS task role has read-only access to the database volume via EFS mount.

config.network: ALB with WAF WebACL -> ECS Fargate:8080

rule_2.name: app-input-length-constraint
rule_2.statement: SizeConstraintStatement on SingleQueryArgument 'value', ComparisonOperator GT, Size 64
rule_2.note: blocks if query param 'value' exceeds 64 bytes

rule_3.name: AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet
rule_3.note: detection only, does not block requests

config.cloudwatch: Alarm on SQLi detection count > 0 in 5min window, SNS notification to security team
config.database: SQLite on EFS volume mounted read-only to task
